description:
This process begins with identifying an employee's development needs or career aspirations.
The manager and HR create a personal development plan, which may include training programs, mentorship, or additional responsibilities.
The employee keeps working on skill enhancement while receiving feedback and evaluation from supervisors.
Once certain milestones are reached, the employee is considered for a promotion or new role.
HR conducts a formal review of performance, and if approved, the promotion is finalized with new responsibilities and compensation adjustments.
The process ends when the employee is promoted and transitions into the new role.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_EmployeeDevelopment" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/employee-development">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_EmployeeDevelopment" name="Employee Development and Promotion" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Roles">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_DevelopmentProcess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IdentifyNeeds</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_EmployeePromoted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Manager" name="Manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FeedbackSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideFeedbackEvaluation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FeedbackJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_MilestonesReached</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConsiderForPromotion</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_HR" name="HR">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PerformanceReview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReviewApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinalizePromotion</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_PromotionNotApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_DevelopmentProcess" name="Development need or career aspiration identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_IdentifyNeeds" name="Identify development needs or career aspirations"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan" name="Create personal development plan (training, mentorship or additional responsibilities)"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" name="Split work and feedback"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ContinueSkillEnhancement" name="Continue skill enhancement"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideFeedbackEvaluation" name="Provide feedback and evaluation"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackJoin" name="Join work and feedback"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_MilestonesReached" name="Milestones reached">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Milestones" name="" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConsiderForPromotion" name="Consider employee for promotion or new role"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PerformanceReview" name="Conduct formal performance review"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReviewApproved" name="Promotion approved?" default="Flow_13">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_FinalizePromotion" name="Finalize promotion with new responsibilities and compensation adjustments"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployeePromoted" name="Employee promoted and transitions into new role"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PromotionNotApproved" name="Promotion not approved"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_DevelopmentProcess" targetRef="Task_IdentifyNeeds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyNeeds" targetRef="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="Task_ContinueSkillEnhancement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedbackEvaluation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_ContinueSkillEnhancement" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedbackEvaluation" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin" targetRef="Event_MilestonesReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Event_MilestonesReached" targetRef="Task_ConsiderForPromotion"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_ConsiderForPromotion" targetRef="Task_PerformanceReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_PerformanceReview" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewApproved" targetRef="Task_FinalizePromotion">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewApproved" targetRef="End_PromotionNotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_FinalizePromotion" targetRef="End_EmployeePromoted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
